import Analysis.Complex.Log
import Analysis.Summable

open Complex

theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {f : ι → ℂ} (hf : Summable f) : Summable fun i => log (1 + f i) := by
  let g : ι → ℂ := fun i => -f i
  have h_g_sum : Summable g := Summable.neg hf
  have h_log_sum : Summable (fun i => log (1 - g i)) :=
    Summable.clog_one_sub h_g_sum
  rw [← neg_neg] at h_log_sum
  exact h_log_sum
